legal_signoff.scope: Every entry below, the channel terms they rely on, and the provenance record kept per distilled example (training-distill.md §3.2).
legal_signoff.note: While status is not 'approved', waymaker_ai.distillation.teacher_policy.gate_record refuses every teacher record, whatever the entry says. Only a person changes this block, after counsel has read the captured terms.

decision_rule: 1. The weights licence (or, for a closed model, the provider terms) allows outputs to train a student that is distributed or used commercially.
2. The terms of the serving channel actually used allow production use, retention and redistribution of outputs, and the kind of data sent.
3. Waymaker's own model policy accepts the model family (backend/services/model_policy.py CHINESE_ONLY_MODEL_PREFIXES).
All three must say yes. Anything not listed here is denied. The most restrictive matching entry wins.
quote_policy: clause_ref.quote holds a verbatim fragment only where the verified notes recorded one verbatim; everywhere else it is null and clause_ref.paraphrase carries the notes' paraphrase. The full captured texts are kept for a legal reviewer outside the repository (scratchpad/research/td_raw/*.txt) and are not reproduced.
